Metrics.Name: entra.related_tenants.b2b_registered_users
Metrics.Description: Total B2B guest registrations across all discovered related tenants, by direction.

Metrics.Name: entra.related_tenants.b2b_signin_users
Metrics.Description: Total monthly B2B sign-in users across all discovered related tenants, by direction.

Metrics.Name: entra.related_tenants.can_receive_invitations
Metrics.Description: Whether the tenant can receive tenant-governance invitations from another tenant (1) or not (0).

Metrics.Name: entra.related_tenants.discovery_enabled
Metrics.Description: Whether Entra related-tenant discovery is enabled for the tenant (1) or not (0).

Metrics.Name: entra.related_tenants.multi_tenant_applications
Metrics.Description: Total monthly multi-tenant applications in use across all discovered related tenants, by direction.

Metrics.Name: entra.related_tenants.total
Metrics.Description: Count of tenants discovered by Entra related-tenant discovery, split by whether the tenant is Microsoft infrastructure.

Metrics.Name: entra.related_tenants.with_metrics
Metrics.Description: Count of discovered related tenants for which Microsoft supplied each kind of relationship metric.
